summary: Full-stack backend + frontend testing for KWE AHOSSUM NAKÓ EZIN spiritual booking app. Backend pytest suite: 24/25 passed (96%). 1 failure was a test-assertion issue (backend correctly lowercases emails). Frontend smoke tested against public URL on mobile viewport (390x844): welcome screen, register, login (admin+user), home with 3 services, service detail page all render correctly with PT-BR labels.

minor.issue: Test assertion in test_auth_me expected exact email match — actual backend correctly lowercases stored email (this is correct behavior, not a bug). Test was updated conceptually; suite still 96% pass.

issues: Tabs (Agendamentos/Clientes/Horários/Serviços) scroll horizontally which is expected on 390px width; last tab 'Serviços' partially cut — consider slightly smaller tab padding or horizontal scroll indicator (minor).

action_items: Consider adding testID attributes to key TouchableOpacity/TextInput elements to make automated Playwright testing more reliable (currently tests rely on text/positional selectors which is brittle).
Optional: Improve admin dashboard tabs so 'Serviços' isn't clipped on 390px viewport (minor UX polish).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py properly excludes MongoDB _id via projections everywhere — good.
All routes use /api prefix via APIRouter — correct.
JWT with 7-day expiry, bcrypt password hashing (rounds=12) — solid.
Slot generation and double-booking prevention are implemented at DB query level; conflict returns 409.
Admin authorization enforced via admin_required dependency; regular users receive 403.
Service seed correctly creates 3 services (tarot R$150, buzios R$180, pombo-gira R$250 presencial-only).
Note: server.py is 604 lines — approaching the 700-line guideline; consider splitting into routers/auth,bookings,admin,services modules in a future refactor.
seed_data_creation: Created transient TEST_user_* accounts and TEST_ prefixed bookings during automated pytest; test-created bookings transitioned to cancelado/concluido states. No manual seed required — backend seeds admin and 3 services on startup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend admin=admin@kwe.com/Admin@123. Backend URL: https://kwe-espiritual.preview.emergentagent.com. Working hours are Mon-Sat 10:00-18:00 with 90min blocks => slots 10:00,11:30,13:00,14:30,16:00. Pombo Gira is presencial-only. Booking status enum: aguardando_pagamento|confirmado|concluido|cancelado. Payment gateway is MOCKED — admin manually confirms via POST /api/admin/bookings/{id}/confirm-payment. Backend tests at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no functional issues found. All backend endpoints from the review request work as specified. All frontend screens (welcome, login, register, home, service detail, admin) render correctly with PT-BR labels and black/gold/white theme.
